senses.gloss: m. (cmp. צְרוֹר II) a stone vessel containing a strainer and having an indented (comb-like) rim; a sort of cooler.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 2:8">Kel. II, 8</cite> <he>המסרק של צ׳</he> if an unclean object touches the ‘comb’ of a cooler; <cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 2:8">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. II, 8</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Eduyot 2:1">Tosef. Eduy. II, 1</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 3:3">Mikv. III, 3</cite> <he>המערה מן הצ׳ ומטיל וכ׳</he> if one pouring water out of a cooler throws water out in several places.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 73a:8">Ab. Zar. 73ᵃ</cite> <he>המערה … מצי׳ קטן וכ׳</he> if one pours forbidden wine from a small cooler into the wine pit.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:2:15">Y. Snh. X, 28ᵈ</cite> top <he>והיה שם צ׳ וכ׳</he> and there stood a pitcher full of Ammonite wine; Bab.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 106a:10">Snh. 106ᵃ</cite> <he>צרצורי</he> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20:1">Num. R. s. 20</cite>; Tanḥ. Balaḳ 18; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 771">Yalk. Num. 771</cite> (ed. Salon. <cite ref="O01650"><he>סרסור</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. to Snh. l. c. note 1).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:13">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> [read:] <he>אפי׳ היה צ׳ של מים בצדו וכ׳</he> even if a pitcher of water had stood by his side, he would have been unable to put his hand forth &c.—Pl. <he>צִרְצוּרִין</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 2:9">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. II, 9</cite>.
